lines: Forty-five extra minutes in bed, and you wake up more tired.
Here's the part nobody tells you.
Every snooze starts a new nap that gets cut off nine minutes later. That isn't rest. That's being woken up six times.
So set one alarm, for the time you actually get up, and put it across the room.
Then open the curtain before you open your phone.
Send this to the friend whose alarm goes off at six, six-oh-nine, six-eighteen.
How many snoozes are you on?
